page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.20xlarge is an x86_64 instance type within the Local SSDs family, engineered for large-scale data processing and storage-heavy workloads. Running on the KVM hypervisor, it features 80 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 704.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 8.8 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Storage architecture is defined by 19,198 GB of integrated local SSD capacity, delivering direct-attached high-capacity non-volatile storage without reliance on remote block volumes. For network-intensive operations, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. Discrete GPUs are not present on this configuration, focusing host resources entirely on CPU processing, local input and output density, and high-capacity memory retention.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, bundling nearly 19.2 TB of local SSD capacity alongside 704 GB of memory makes the ecs.i2ne.20xlarge cost-effective for I/O-intensive workloads that would otherwise require expensive high-throughput networked disks. The 8.8:1 memory-to-core ratio suits memory-demanding engines. It is appropriate for large transactional and analytical databases, distributed file systems, real-time search clusters, and big data frameworks requiring rapid local disk access.
